name: calendar-manager
description: Eight agents run Paul's calendar SOP from cloud routines (desktop fallback): conflicts, commute and travel blocks, colors, notes, 1:1s, invites missing from his calendar and holds on times he offers by email, all time-zone strict. They ask when unsure and learn from each answer, kept in a private memory repo. A hook blocks deletes, invites (Callie on travel excepted), RSVPs, messages and force-pushes.
